pole_a.label: ai_as_tool
sentences: AI handles the repetitive parts of the job here, freeing your attention for decisions that need a human.
We equip every team with AI assistants that amplify what they can build.
AI here is a collaborator in your toolkit, with you making the calls.
Our AI tools handle the busywork so you have more time for the interesting parts of the job.
We give you access to the best AI models and let you decide how they fit your workflow.
We deploy AI to augment the capabilities of every team member.
You decide when and how AI supports your work; the judgment stays yours.
Think of AI as a power tool we provide — training included, usage up to you.

pole_b.label: ai_as_mandate
sentences: Fluency with AI tools is a baseline expectation for every role here.
Before we open a new position, we ask whether AI can deliver the outcome instead.
Using AI effectively is part of how performance is evaluated in every function.
We expect every employee to make AI their default way of getting work done.
We are an AI-first company, and every role is expected to work that way from day one.
Asking for more headcount means first showing that AI couldn't do the job.
We hire people who treat AI as the first tool they reach for, every time.
Every workflow is expected to be rebuilt around AI, and every role is measured against that standard.
